data.description: Element water; Type form infusion; Level 4; Burn 3 Associated Blasts charged water, water Saving Throw Reflex half You diffuse your kinetic blast to spray out wildly. All creatures and objects in a 30-foot cone take half your normal amount of blast damage. The saving throw DC is Dexterity-based.
